limitations: Operating PV/storage capacities are retained assumptions, not validated depot sizing. Reassess depot and station energy duties after distributed overnight placement and charging are represented.
PV area is module area at the catalogue 0.15 kWp/m2, not gross land area; setbacks, access and packing require layout.
Battery footprint and separation require supplier/fire-engineering data; no area or approval is invented.
Dispatch queues are initial simulator placements, not an overnight operating plan. Slot lengths use one train plus 5 m at each end from RFC 0014.
Workshop bays and passenger platforms are not credited as verified overnight stabling slots.
open_gates: itemised depot energy budget and allowance reconciliation
station and depot storage layouts with usable tracks
coordinated morning starts and conflict-aware evening run-in/morning run-out
